name: 73142 · Oklahoma City, OK
findings: ZIP 73142 (Oklahoma City) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73142 (Oklahoma City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
